name: P-058 ARM cold precheck3 original host output failure
summary: Original coldprecheck3 wrapper failed because the host UID1000 attempted to rewrite profile.cpuprofile already saved by guest UID1001. The ARM cold fixture captured a valid profile and exited by SIGTERM with owned cleanup. This original FAIL remains unchanged.
